title: Shulker build state
description: What the last build wrote into a directory, kept in its .shulker/state.json. Shulker writes this file; it is a record of the last build, never read as intent.

$schema.description: The version of this file, as a published schema URL.

side.description: The side the directory was built for.

source.description: Where the project was synced from, when it wasn't built from a local project.

ref.description: The git ref the synced project was read at.

path.description: The folder of the git repository the synced project was read from.

commit.description: The git commit the synced project was read at.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the archive the synced project was read from.

lockSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the shulker.lock the build used.

minecraft.description: The Minecraft version the directory was built with.

loader.description: The mod loader the directory was built with.

files.description: Every file the build wrote, by path relative to the directory, with the SHA-256 it was written with. A file listed here that still has that hash is shulker's to replace or remove.

managedValues.description: The keys the build set in files it shares with the player, by file, with the values it set.

links.description: The data folders the build linked into the directory.

packs.description: The file name each resource pack was placed under, by key, so a renamed pack's entry in the enabled list can follow it.

installedLoader.description: The loader its own installer set up in the directory. The installer's files aren't listed in files.

launcherImage.description: The hash of the instance image shulker last wrote into the launcher.
